name: repo-tor
title: Git Analytics Dashboard
description: Extract and visualize commit history from any git repository. Generate insights on progress, contributors, and code quality.
audience: Developers who want to see their own output, team leads tracking contributor patterns, and managers who need a visual summary of engineering progress without reading git logs.
useCases: A developer preparing for a performance review — pulls up their commit activity across all repos to show consistent output and areas of focus
A team lead notices a project is stalling — checks the dashboard to see if commits have dropped off and which contributors are active
A manager needs to report engineering progress to stakeholders — switches to the Executive view for a high-level summary without technical detail
A developer embeds their personal activity chart on their CV site — uses the iframe embed with colours matched to their portfolio theme

dataPrivacy.storage: Dashboard data loaded from static JSON files. No user data collected.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: GitHub API used for extraction scripts (optional).
